tests.name: bjdata_read_half_ndarray
tests.intent: Verify that BJData ND-arrays with element type 'h' (float16) successfully parse and map to the 'half' type name.

tests.name: bjdata_char_ndarray_valid_range
tests.intent: Verify that BJData ND-arrays of char with values within 0..127 parse successfully.

tests.name: bjdata_char_ndarray_invalid_range
tests.intent: Verify that BJData ND-arrays of char containing values above 127 are rejected with parse_error.113.

tests.name: bjdata_write_char_ndarray_range_fallback
tests.intent: Verify that writing an ND-array with char values exceeding 127 falls back to a plain object instead of a packed array.

tests.name: bjdata_write_char_ndarray_valid_packed
tests.intent: Verify that writing an ND-array with char values fully within 0..127 produces a packed representation.

tests.name: gen_08
tests.intent: Test binary reader detecting EOF when parsing ND-array of char

tests.name: gen_09
tests.intent: Test binary reader rejecting char > 127 in ND-array with parse_error.113

tests.name: gen_10
